title: Characterization of MdDOX-Co homologs revealed a novel gibberellin metabolic clade and a single-residue switch dictating the catalytic site.
authors: Inoue, Taiki; Karasuno, Yusaku; Wakabayashi, Takatoshi; Okada, Kazuma; Miyazaki, Sho; Takahashi, Ikuo; Okada, Kazunori; Kuzuyama, Tomohisa; Nakajima, Masatoshi
one_liner_zh: 该文通过结构预测、分子对接和MD模拟揭示MdDOX-Co同源物中单个残基开关决定赤霉素羟化位点，虽以酶为对象但结构计算方法可迁移至蛋白质结构-功能研究。
abstract: The metabolism of gibberellin (GA) is generally mediated by GA 2-oxidase (GA2ox) through 2beta-hydroxylation. These enzymes belong to the 2-oxoglutarate-dependent dioxygenase (2ODD, DOX) superfamily. However, MdDOX-Co, another 2ODD, was recently found to catalyze atypical GA 12alpha-hydroxylation. MdDOX-Co belongs to the DOXC41 clade, which is phylogenetically distant from the canonical GA2ox. The evolutionary and structural bases of this unique catalytic site remain unclear. In this study, we investigated the functional divergence of the DOXC41 clade. Through phylogenetic analyses, biochemical experiments with recombinant enzymes, and GC-MS detection, we discovered that MdDOX-Co homologs exhibit striking diversity in their GA hydroxylation sites, branching into two functional types: those possessing 12alpha-hydroxylation activity and those possessing 2-hydroxylation activity. We performed enzyme structure predictions, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to elucidate the mechanisms that dictate this functional diversity. These in silico approaches identified a key residue that distinguishes the two activities. Subsequent biochemical characterization using a synthesized variant demonstrated that a single-residue switch (T214P) shifted the catalytic activity of MdDOX-Co from 12alpha-hydroxylation to 2beta-hydroxylation. Our findings provide new insights into the structural rationale of how a single amino acid dictates the hydroxylation sites of GA in this novel metabolic clade.
abstract_zh: 赤霉素（GA）的代谢通常由GA 2-氧化酶（GA2ox）通过2β-羟基化介导。这些酶属于2-氧戊二酸依赖性双加氧酶（2ODD, DOX）超家族。然而，最近发现另一种2ODD酶MdDOX-Co可催化非典型的GA 12α-羟基化。MdDOX-Co属于DOXC41分支，在系统发育上与典型的GA2ox相距较远。这种独特催化位点的进化和结构基础仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们探讨了DOXC41分支的功能分化。通过系统发育分析、重组酶的生化实验以及GC-MS检测，我们发现MdDOX-Co同源物在GA羟基化位点上表现出显著多样性，分为两种功能类型：具有12α-羟基化活性的类型和具有2-羟基化活性的类型。我们进行了酶结构预测、分子对接和分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，以阐明决定这种功能多样性的机制。这些计算模拟方法识别出一个关键残基，用于区分两种活性。随后，使用合成变体的生化表征表明，单残基切换（T214P）将MdDOX-Co的催化活性从12α-羟基化转变为2β-羟基化。我们的发现为这一新型代谢分支中单个氨基酸如何决定GA羟基化位点提供了结构基础的新见解。
